description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing test server connections, including WebSocket transport, event handling, and message communication for a test server in the Playwright project.

classes.name: TestServerConnectionClosedError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating the test server connection has been closed.

classes.name: TestServerTransport
classes.description: Interface defining methods for test server transport mechanisms.

classes.name: WebSocketTestServerTransport
classes.description: Implementation of TestServerTransport using WebSocket for communication.

classes.name: TestServerConnection
classes.description: Main class managing the connection to the test server, handling messaging, events, and connection state.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the connection is closed.

methods.name: _sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with a method and optional parameters, awaiting a reply.

methods.name: _sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message without waiting for a reply.

methods.name: _dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches events based on received message method.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to the server.

methods.name: pingNoReply
methods.description: Sends a ping message without expecting a reply.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Starts watching for test server events.

methods.name: watchNoReply
methods.description: Starts watching without expecting a reply.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a connection or resource on the server.

methods.name: resizeTerminal
methods.description: Resizes the terminal in the test server.

methods.name: checkBrowsers
methods.description: Checks available browsers on the server.
